title: Rapid Qualify & Scale — Mini Deck (sketch)
content:
Slide 1 — Purpose and TL;DR
- One-slide: how sellers can close small pilot commitments and scale to Reserved Capacity.
- TL;DR speaker note: "This mini-deck is a tactical cheat for SEs and AEs to run sub-6-week pilots, measure unit economics, and convert to a committed deployment. Focus on metrics that map directly to buying signals: p95 latency, cost/token, error-rate, and business issue resolution rate."

Slide 2 — Quick qualification checklist (30s)
- "Is latency-critical for the customer?" (yes/no) -> If yes, prioritize Dedicated or regions.
- "Does data need to stay in-customer network?" -> If yes, route to Private.
- "Expected peak QPS and burst patterns?" -> If >200 qps, consider Dedicated pools.
- "Regulatory/compliance must-haves?" -> List (SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR)
- Speaker note: use this to triage customers into pilot tracks: quick embed, pilot with caching, or dedicated onramp.

Slide 3 — Pilot designs (3 rapid paths)
- Fast-Embed pilot (2–3 days): SDK + single-api route, prefix caching, model variant L (lower cost)
  - Success metric: integrated in staging + <100ms median, and 50k tokens/day sustained
- Ops-Light pilot (2–3 weeks): sandbox environment, monitoring hooks, SLO alpha, controlled ramp
  - Success metric: p95 < 500ms, error rate < 0.5%, evidence of 10% reduction in human review workload
- Dedicated Proof (4–6 weeks): reserved pool, canary traffic, performance baseline
  - Success metric: throughput baseline and cost model validated for committed TCO

Slide 4 — Rallying the buyer: measurement plan template
- Key KPIs to agree in week 0: latency (p50/p95), tokens/day, cost per 1k tokens, model quality (NPS/accuracy), business ops delta
- Minimum data artifacts we need: sample log stream, expected prompt templates, success examples, volume forecast
- Speaker note: bring this template to kickoff and pre-fill before contract.

Slide 5 — Common objections and quick rebuttals
- "We can't predict cost" -> "We provide a 3-week forecast and granular token-level breakdown; propose a small committed trial to validate unit economics."
- "Latency concerns" -> "Canary on region + Dedicated pool; fallback to smaller model with graceful degradation policy."
- "Vendor lock" -> "Same API across Hosted/Dedicated/Private; customers can export config and pin versions."
- "Quality regressions" -> "We run evals on your prompt set and surface regression alerts; rollbacks and canary strategies included."

Slide 6 — Sales play scripts (30s‑60s)
- Cold intro script for integration lead: "We help you run a 2‑week embed that proves latency and cost. If we hit the agreed KPI, we help map to a committed capacity plan. Can I schedule a 20‑minute tech kickoff?"
- Buyer handoff template to SE: include sample prompts, volume forecast, success criteria, security checklist.

Slide 7 — Operational runbook (SE/PD checklist)
- Pre-kickoff: collect logs, model prompts, test dataset, IAM list, SLA expectations
- Week 0–1: baseline tests (latency, tokenization, memory), monitor KV cache hit-rate
- Week 2–3: ramp policy, canary with 5–10% traffic, throttle rules, alerts
- Post-pilot: cost analysis, model selection recommendation, handoff pack for Dedicated onboarding

Slide 8 — Fallthrough strategies and economics
- If cost too high -> propose quantized model variant + caching + shorter context window
- If latency bad -> prioritize regional Dedicated + kernel-optimized runtime
- Economics quick calc (example): baseline hosted cost = $X/1M tokens; with caching and batching expect 30–60% reduction; show math sample

Slide 9 — Live demo plan (10 min)
- Minimal reproducible example: sample prompt set, 2 routes (hosted vs cached), visualization of p95, tokens/day
- Demo script bullets for SE

Slide 10 — Next steps & action items
- AE: confirm pilot budget and timeline
- SE: pre-fill measurement template and book kickoff
- Solutions Eng: prepare canary config and fallback mapping

Notes to self/To-dos
- Convert slide 4 measurement plan into a Google Sheet template (owner: Priya)
- Add checkboxes for regulatory artifacts needed for Private deploys
- Run a dry-run with internal Platform team to validate the demo script
